generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of Karnataka Public Procurement Portal portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The Tender processing fee shall not be refundable

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Deputy Director reserves the right to verify the documents before approval
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and compete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work

The successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in the form of DD/FDR in the name of the Deputy Director, Mysore Palace Board, Mysore given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with the Conditions of Contract.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent

All the items in the tender include all lead, lifts, loading unloading, transportation, labour, hire charges of machinery, cost and conveyance of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work
All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public/ private properties
Contractor should take all precautionary measures to avoid any damage to the utilities during utility shifting. To that extent the contractor should indemnify the client
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost
Contractor should clear all the materials and make clean immediately after completion of the event
Contractor shall prepare detailed artwork/design and submit it for approval before fabrication

The Contractor shall submit an undertaking confirming that he/she has visited and inspected the proposed site, examined and understood the design/drawing of the backdrop, and discussed the proposed materials, construction methodology and other technical requirements with the Engineer-in-Charge before submission of the bid. The Contractor shall be deemed to have fully understood the scope of work, design requirements, site conditions and material specifications and shall execute the work accordingly without any additional claim on this account.
All materials, labour, transportation, erection, dismantling, maintenance, tools, machinery and incidental requirements shall be deemed included in the quoted rate
All temporary structures shall be adequately braced, anchored/weighted and made safe against normal wind and weather conditions
Contractor shall keep the backdrop, LED screen and associated installations in good working condition throughout the 8-day period
Damaged thermocol/fibre/decorative components and defective LED modules shall be repaired/replaced without additional cost
All electrical connections shall be properly insulated, protected and earthed
After completion of the programme, the contractor shall dismantle and remove all temporary installations and clear the site
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Notification and kw2
The bidder shall posses GST registration certificate the necessary document issued by competent authority shall be uploaded
The bidder shall have sufficient labour & material to work round the clock

With in TEN days of the receipt of letter of acceptance the successful tenderer shall deliver to the employer the security deposit of 5% on total amount in FDR Format plus additional security for unbalanced tender.

To qualify for award of this Contract, the Tenderer, in its own name, shall have satisfactorily completed at least one work of similar nature during the last five years in providing, erecting and fixing of backdrops having artistic, decorative, thematic, cultural, heritage or architectural designs, including backdrops executed for Palaces, Heritage Buildings, Heritage Sites, Government/Cultural Events, Festivals, Dasara or similar prestigious events, involving decorative facade treatment, artistic elements and associated structural arrangements.

Backdrops consisting only of LED screens/display systems, plain or standard corporate event backdrops, exhibition backdrops without artistic/design elements, or similar conventional backdrops shall not be considered for meeting the experience requirement

The experience certificate shall specifically establish the required minimum 60 ft. length. Certificates which do not mention the length/dimensions of the backdrop or stage shall not be considered for establishing this eligibility criterion

Bidder must have experience of completed such type of work successfully i.e., Similar Nature of work either from Department of Archaeology, Museums and Heritage of Karnataka or Any other State or Archaeological Survey of India or Mysore Palace Board or any Heritage site in last five years

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years Satisfactorily completed, as prime contractor, at least one similar nature of work of value not less than Rs. 17.50 Lakhs. Certificate issued not below the rank of Exe. Engineer shall be uploaded.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years period achieved in at least two financial years an average financial turnover of value not less than Rs. 35.00 Lakhs.
The Bidder should make arrangement for LED walls with graphics suggested by the authority
The bidder should not use the Plastic materials (ex: Flux, Banners etc.)
The bidder should upload the photos of previously done backdrop along with work done certificate
The bidder should take care of backdrop materials such that the backdrop should look good for complete event of 8days
The bidder should upload work done satisfactory certificate. Work order or Bill copy will not be accepted. The work done certificate with the amount mentioned shall only will be considered
Rates Quoted should be for 8 complete days and including preparation days
